Ālambanīyabhāvena, upādānopakārato;Pañcupādānakkhandhāti, lokuttaravivajjitā.
Cārako kāraṇaṃ tattha, aparādho ca kārako;Aparādhakato coro, iti copamitā puna.
Vimaddāsahanaṃ rūpaṃ, pheṇapiṇḍaṃva dubbalaṃ;Muhuttaramaṇīyattā, vedanā bubbuḷūpamā.
Suññagāmova daṭṭhabba-majjhattikamasārato;Gāmaghātakacorāva, taṃ hanantaṃva bāhiraṃ.
Bhāro ca bhāradānañca, bhāranikkhepanaṃ tathā;Bhāranikkhepanūpāyo, iccopammaṃ yathākkamaṃ.
Tīramorimasaṅkhātaṃ, mahogho pārimaṃ tathā;Tadatikkamupāyoti, upamenti ca taṃ budhā.
Taṃ vinā nāññato dukkhaṃ, na hoti na ca taṃ tato;Dukkhahetuniyāmena, saccamāha visattikaṃ.
Nāññaṃ maggāca niyyānaṃ, aniyyāno na cāpi so;Tasmā niyyānabhāvena, maggo saccanti sammato.
Tadetaṃ paṭivijjhanti, ariyāva catubbidhaṃ;Vuttamariyasaccanti, tasmā nāthena taṃ kathaṃ;
Jāti jarā ca maraṇaṃ, soko ca paridevanā;Dukkhañca domanassañca, upāyāso tathāparo.
Appiyehi ca saṃyogo, vippayogo piyehi ca;Yampi na labhaticchanto, tampi dukkhamidaṃ mataṃ.
Socantā paridevantā, vedentā dukkhavedanaṃ;Domanassehi santattā, upāyāsavighātino.
Iṭṭhehi piyakantehi, manāpehi viyojitā;Saṅkhārehi ca sattehi, nānāsampattidāyibhi.
Dukkhāpagamamicchantā, patthayantā sukhāgamaṃ;Alabbhaneyyadhammesu, pipāsāturamānasā.
Kicchādhipannā kapaṇā, vipphandantā rudammukhā;Taṇhādāsā parābhūtā, bhavasaṃsārasaṃkaṭe.
Have virāgatejena, vicchinne sati sabbathā;Kena bandhena santāna-mānessati bhavantaraṃ.
Tasmā mokkhavipakkhena, taṇhādukkhavidhāyinī;Dukkhasamudayo nāma, saccamiccāha nāyako.
Vuttamācariyenetaṃ, paṭṭhānanayasaṅgahe;Labbhamānanayaṃ tāva, dassanatthaṃ papañcito.
Vuttā kāyavacīcittasaṅkhārāti mahesinā;Saṅkhārāti vibhattevamekūnatiṃsa cetanā.
Itthaṃ bhedena saṅgayha, dvādasaṅgaṃ vicakkhaṇā;Atthāpattivisesena, vīsatākāramīrayuṃ.
Tathāpi tesaṃ dhammānaṃ, vatthulakkhaṇabhedato;Dīpavaṭṭisikhānaṃva, natthi ekantamekatā.
Atthadhammapaṭivedha-desanānaṃ yathākkamaṃ;Atigambhīrabhāvena, catugambhīramīritaṃ.
Upādāniyadhammesu, taṇhāsnehapipāsitā;Daḷhī kubbantupādānaṃ, piyarūpābhinandino.
Vaṭṭassa dvādasaṅgassa, tassa tebhūmakassa tu;Dukkhakkhandhassa dassesi, nissandena nidass
Sokañca paridevañca, tathā dukkhañca kāyikaṃ;Domanassamupāyāsaṃ, nānābyasanasambhavaṃ.
Iccāturamaniccantaṃ, mahopaddavasaṅkulaṃ;Bahupaklesupassaṭṭhaṃ, dukkhametanti piṇḍitaṃ.
Tato sānusayā taṇhā, nirujjhati punabbhave;Santānaratiyābhāvā, na pakkhandati sandhiyaṃ.
Aviruḷhikabhāvena, tattha vaṭṭavirodhite;Abhisaṅkhārabhāvena, na pavattanti cetanā.
Paṭisandhipavattīpi, na janenti bhavantare;Iccāvijjānirodhena, niruddhā kammacetanā.
Paccayatthanirodhena, saṅkhārānaṃ nirodhato;Viññāṇaṃ janakābhāvā, niruddhamiti vuccati.
Candādāvaṭṭanādīhi, disākālādisammuti;Pārampariyakādīhi, jātigottakulādayo.
Lokavohārikaṭṭhena, paññattaṃ paramatthato;Avijjamānametāya, paññāpenti yadā tadā.
Devadattotha medhāvī, vedanā candimā tathā;Khattiyo narasīho ca, bhātā lohitakaṃ yuvā.
Sāyaṃ paññatti viññeyyā, lokasaṅketanimmitā;Vacīviññattisahito, saddo evāti kecana.
Itthaṃ paññattidhammāti, vuttaṃ paññattikadvayaṃ;Tathādhivacanā dhammā, niruttīti ca tādin
Avisaṃvādakaṭṭhena, lokavohārasādhakaṃ;Samaññāsaccamiccevaṃ, ācikkhanti vicakkhaṇā.

Paṭisaṅkhāya sodhetvā, chadvāresu malāsavaṃ;Chaḷindriyāni medhāvī, satārakkhena gopaye.
Cha senāsanamārabbha, dhutaṅgānīti terasa;Kappiyepi ca loluppa-samācāravimuttiyā.
Sāmīcipaṭipattīti, katvā sallekhavuttiyā;Paccayattayamāhacca, paññattāni mahesinā.

Sīmantadārunagara-kkhettapaccantanissitaṃ;Visabhāgamasappāyaṃ, paṭṭanaṃ mittadullabhaṃ.
Nātidūraṃ nāccāsannaṃ, appasaddamanākulaṃ;Gamanāgamanasampannaṃ, appaḍaṃsānupaddavaṃ.
Akicchapaccayuppādaṃ, lajjībhikkhugaṇocitaṃ;Vivekaṭṭhānabahulaṃ, bahussutanisevitaṃ.
Āvāsaṃ gocaraṃ bhassaṃ, puggalaṃ bhojanaṃ tathā;Vajjentotumasappāyaṃ, iriyāpathamattano.
Appassādā mahādukkhā, kāmā hi kaṭukapphalā;Dussaṃhārā durārakkhā, bahvādīnavasaṇṭhitā.
Paṭivāte tiṇukkāva, pariggāhakadāhino;Aṅgārakāsusaṅkāsā, sabbaṅgaparitāsakā.
Sattisūlūpamā daḷhaṃ, taṇhāsallānuvedhino;Ghorānatthavisākiṇṇā, kaṇhasappasirūpamā.
Sabbāsavaparikliṭṭhā, sabbāsaṃklesavatthukā;Gammā ca capalā nīcā, puthujjanamamāyitā.
Manoramasubhākārā, piyarūpopalambhino;Mittamukhaṃ sapattāva, vañcayanti mahājanaṃ.
Sīghavāhī mahoghoyaṃ, klesavaṭṭaṃ mahabbhayo;Sakaṇṭakañca gahanaṃ, paṅkova duratikkamo.
Cetosaṃmohanaṭṭhānaṃ, pamādapaṭisandhitaṃ;Ohāri sithilaṃ cetaṃ, duppamuñcañca bandhanaṃ.
Jālaṃva vitthataṃ loke,Mārapāso samoḍḍito;Pañjaraṃ cārako ceso,Sattānamanayāvaho.
Yatthānurāgasambaddhā, paliguṇṭhitasāyino;Makkaṭālepabaddhāva, nitthunanti vighātino.
Baḷisaṃvāmisacchannaṃ, savisaṃ viya bhojanaṃ;Migaluddanivāpova, vināsāya samoḍḍitā.
Mīnakā vaṅkagiddhāva, ye gilitvā puthujjanā;Ghoraṃ maccumukhaṃ patvā, socantāpāyabhāgino.
Ajjhositā panettha ca, lobhamucchāvidāhino;Kodhūpanāhajalitā, issāmaccheradhūpitā.
Sārambhāyudhasannaddhā, vipphurantā manorathā;Ābandhicchā mahākacchā, ṭhanti lokavipattiyā
Bhayasantāsabahulā, sabbānatthānusārino;Sādhentā caturāpāyaṃ, pāpakammapurakkhakā.
Gāmasūkarapotāva, kāmāsucipariplutā;Camarīkatakammantā, asmiṃ loke palobhitā.
Paraṃ pamādābhivaṭṭhā, pāpaklesamahodakā;Tato taṇhānadī pūrā, pāpetāpāyasāgaraṃ.
Klesacārakamokkhāya, dvārametamanuttaraṃ;Mahoghuttaraṇaṃ kullaṃ, sotthi pārimapāpakaṃ.
Pāpacoravighātāya, khemamaggo anuttaro;Akaṇṭako agahano, uju sabbhi pavedito.
Mahābandhanamokkhāya,Abbhuto jinaghosito;Palibodhapariccāgo,Abbhokāso alepano.
Saṅgapaṅkasamuttāro, ganthānaṃ viniveṭhanaṃ;Taṇhādāsabyanitthāro, seribhāvo sukhāvaho.
Mārapāsasamucchedī, pattametamanuttaraṃ;Mohandhakāraviddhaṃsī, vijjālokavirocano.
Sabbasantāpaharaṇamidaṃ sītaṃva candanaṃ;Nimmalaṃ dhammasalilaṃ, saṃklesamalasodhanaṃ.
Cittātaṅkasamuddhaṃsī, paribhogasukhosadhaṃ;Lokāmisānaṃ vamanaṃ, cetodosavirecanaṃ.
Anivatti ca paccakkhamāvenikamabhāriyaṃ;Amatosadhamaccantamajarāmarasādhanaṃ.
Sammājīvadhajaṃ rammaṃ, hirottappapaṭicchadaṃ;Vimuttāmatasambhogaṃ, veneyyajanasevitaṃ.
Sabbāsavamalopeto, sabbopaklesasañcayo;Pāpayakkhasamo ceso, dosāsīvisasaṅgamo.
Dhiratthu pāpadhammānaṃ, sabbakalyāṇahāyinaṃ;Laddhāpi khaṇasampatti, dullabhā yehi nāsitā.
Saddhammadhanacorā te, nekkhammapatibandhakā;Paṭipattiṃ vilumpantā, palibundhanti pāṇino.
Tepi vāsenti dummedhā, nissaṅkā mohapārutā;Antomanasi ucchaṅke, ghoramāsīvisaṃ yathā.
Attano ca vināsāya, nissaṭaṃ klesapañjare;Cinantā nāvabujjhanti, vipattipathayāyino.
Pāpacintā paribyuḷhā, vitakkamathitā janā;Lokadvayāpi dhaṃsenti, atthadvayavināsino.
Mānātimānabahulā, mudhāmukharacaṇḍikā;Uddhatā ca pamattā ca, dabbitā ketugāhino.
Visayassādavikkhittā, vikiṇṇā pākatindriyā;Muṭṭhassatī kusītā ca, jīvanti moghajīvitaṃ.
Mahagghasā bāhulikā, duppaññā kāyadaḷhikā;Ganthanīvaraṇābaddhā, icchālobhavasīkatā.
Dubbharatā ca dupposā, sukumārasukhālayā;Asantuṭṭhā mahicchā ca, loluppācāralakkhitā.
Nillajjā vītasārajjā, lokadhammesu mucchitā;Pāpicchā kuhanacchannā, micchājīvapalobhitā.
Saṭhā pagabbhā māyāvī, antopūti avassutā;Saṅkassarasamācārā, kasambu sithilā jaḷā.
Kāmagiddhā durācārā, dussīlā mohapārutā;Khajjantā kaddamībhūtā, jinasāsanakaṇṭakā.
Vipannākulakammantā, pāpakārī parājitā;Socanti dīghamaddhānaṃ, apāyamhi samappitā.
Khippamādittacelova, pāpapāvakamuṭṭhitaṃ;Bhāvanājalasekena, nibbāpeyya nirantaraṃ.
Okappento vimuccanto, paññavā paṭipattiyaṃ;Pihayanto mamāyanto, sammāsambuddhasāsanaṃ.
Cetokāḷakāpagato, bhāvanārasamuttamaṃ;Raṅgaṃ niddhotavatthaṃva, sādhukaṃ paṭigaṇhati.
Pāpagāhavinimutto, rāhumuttova candimā;Guṇaraṃsiparikkhitto, sobheti jinasāsanaṃ.
Bhāvanāninnasantāno, kallacitto visārado;Kasiṇādikamārabbha, bhāveyya samathaṃ kathaṃ.
Niggayha uddhataṃ cittaṃ, paggayha līnamānasaṃ;Ūhataṃ sampahaṃsento, upekkhanto samāhitaṃ.
Reṇumhi uppaladale, sutte nāvāya nāḷiyā;Yathā madhukarādīnaṃ, pavatti samma vaṇṇitā.
Cittapavattiākāraṃ, sādhukaṃ lakkhayaṃ budho;Tathā samenākārena, pahitatto parakkame.
Dasadhā kasiṇānevaṃ, bhāvetvā pana yogino;Catukkapañcakajjhānaṃ, katvā vikkhepanissaṭā.
Pādādibhaṅgavikkhittaṃ, hatavikkhittakaṃ mataṃ;Lohitaṃ lohitākiṇṇaṃ, puḷavaṃ kimisaṅkulaṃ.
Tatthevaṃ dasadhā bhede, nijjīvakuṇapāsubhe;Ujjhite bhūmibhāgasmiṃ, matakāye kaḷevare.
Labbhamānakamākāraṃ, oloketvā salakkhaṇaṃ;Uggahetvāna cittena, taṃtaṃnāmena bhāvaye.
Yathā idaṃ tathā etaṃ, yathā etaṃ tathā idaṃ;Jīvamānañca nijjīvameva dhammaparāyaṇaṃ.
Bahi maṭṭhamupaṭṭhāti, anto kuṇapapūritaṃ;Uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ, navadvāramalassavaṃ.
Positampi ciraṃ kālaṃ, mamaṃkāramamāyitaṃ;Lahudujjanamittova, pīḷitaṃ sampadussati.
Saviññattivikārehi, vicittākāramaṇḍito;Kāyo līḷavilāsehi, palambheti mahājanaṃ.
Vañcitā yena dummedhā, kāmaklesamalīmayā;Pūrenti caturāpāyaṃ, māradheyyānusārino.
Saddhāpabbajito yogī, bhāventonussatiṃ pana;Dasānussatibhedesu, bhāveyyaññataraṃ kathaṃ.
Arahaṃ sugato loke, bhagavā lokapāragū;Vijjācaraṇasampanno, vimuttiparināyako.
Cakkhumā titthakusalo, dhammassāmī tathāgato;Maccudheyyavimokkhāya, paṭipādayi pāṇino.
Satthavāho mahāyoggo, maggāmaggayudhandharo;Sirisatthamadhiggayha, vicarittha mahāpathaṃ,
Anomo asamo dhīro,Lokahītaparakkamo;Sabbākāravaropeto,Accherabbhutapuggalo.
Chabbaṇṇaraṃsilalito, ratanagghiyasannibho;Samiddhirūpasobhaggo, dassaneyyaṃva piṇḍitaṃ.
Phullaṃ padumasaṇḍaṃva, kapparukkhovalaṅkato;Nabhaṃva tārakākiṇṇaṃ, uttamo paṭidissati.
Niddhotamalacandova, nakkhattaparivārito;Khattasaṅghaparibyuḷho, cakkavattīva sobhati.
Klesasaṃkaṭaduggamhā, dukkhakkhandhamahabbhayā;Khemantabhūmiṃ niyyāti, accantamanupaddavaṃ
Caturoghanimuggānaṃ, setubandho samuggato;Bhavacārakaruddhānaṃ, mahādvāro apāruto.
Sokopāyāsaviddhānaṃ, paridevasamaṅginaṃ;Sallanīharaṇopāyo, accantasukhamīrito.
Bhavayogā vinimuttā, pahīnabhayabheravā;Accantasukhamedhenti, sotthipattā mahesayo.
Ujumaggamadhiṭṭhāya, mārakāyappadālano;Aparājitasaṅgāmo, lalitodātavikkamo.
Āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo,Dakkhiṇeyyo sudullabho;Sadevakassa lokassa,Puññakkhettamanuttaraṃ.
Ādi cetaṃ patiṭṭhā ca, mukhaṃ pamukhamuttamaṃ;Mūlaṃ kusaladhammānaṃ, pabhavaṃ paṭipattiyā.
‘‘Suladdhā vata me laddhā, saddhā sugatasāsane;Sīlaṃ me yassa kalyāṇaṃ, parisuddhamakhaṇḍi
‘‘Dullabho vata me laddho,Mahālābho anappako;Yohamakkhalitācāro,Upaghātavivajjito.
Saddhāya sīlavantesu, datvā dānaṃ yathārahaṃ;Niddhotamalamacchero, vivitto tamanussare.
Kopadāhopasamanaṃ, maccheramalasodhanaṃ;Pamādaniddāvuṭṭhānaṃ, lobhapāsavimocanaṃ.
Appamaññāpadaṭṭhānaṃ, appameyyena vaṇṇitaṃ;Mahāpurisacārittaṃ, sapadānaṃ mahesinā.
Dhammādhigatabhogānaṃ, sārādānamanuttaraṃ;Mahattādhigamūpāyaṃ, lokasantatikāraṇaṃ.
Dānavossaggasammukho,Saṃvibhāgarato sukhī;Kapparukkhova phalito,Jāto lokābhivaḍḍhiyā.
Taṃ lokamupapannāse, sassirīkaṃ parāyaṇaṃ;Iddhimanto jutimanto, vaṇṇavanto yasassino.
Saddhammaguṇasampatti-dātā maṅgalanāyikā;Dullabhāpi ca me laddhā, saddhā sugatasāsane.
Maccheramalanittiṇṇo, lobhakkhandhavimuccito;Opānabhūto lokasmiṃ, vissaṭṭhasukhayācano.
Khemaṃ taṃ pārimatīra-mahāyanakaraṃ paraṃ;Tāṇaṃ leṇañca dīpañca, patiṭṭhānaṃ parāyaṇaṃ.
Lokappavatti cintetvā, maraṇānussatiṃ pana;Bhāveyya sakamaccantaṃ, cintento maraṇaṃ kathaṃ
Animittamanaññātaṃ, maccānamidha jīvitaṃ;Kasirañca parittañca, tañca dukkhena saṃyutaṃ.
Appodakamhi maccheva, bandhamāne rudammukhe;Maccu gacchati ādāya, pekkhamāne mahājane.
Purakkhatvāva maraṇaṃ, jāyanti paṭisandhiyaṃ;Jātā puna marissanti, evaṃdhammā hi pāṇino.
Yepi dīghāyukā devā, vaṇṇavantā mahiddhikā;Ānubhāvabalappattā, mahābhogasukhedhino.
Tepi maccusamuddhattā, bhavanti bhayasaṃkulā;Verambhakkhittapakkhīva, mādisesu kathāva kā.
Accantarāyabahulo, maraṇāhitasambhavo;Niccaṃ cakkasamāruḷho, lokoyaṃ parivattati.
Accheraṃ vata lokasmiṃ, khaṇamattampi jīvitaṃ;Nissitopaddavaṭṭhāne, mahābyasanapīḷite.
Atthamārabbha gacchanto, ādiccova nabhantare;Maraṇāyābhidhāvanto, vihāyāmi suve suve.
Vajjhappatto mahācoro,Niyyātāghātanaṃ yathā;Maraṇāya payātohaṃ,Tathevamanivattiyo.
Ambujova vaṅkaghasto, tāṇaleṇavivajjito;Niccaṃ maccuvasaṃ yanto, vissaṭṭho kimahaṃ care.
Ko me hāso kimānando,Kimahaṃ mohapāruto;Madappamādavikkhitto,Vicarāmi niraṅkuso?

Pubbo ca lohitaṃ sedo,Medo assu vasātha vā;Kheḷo siṅghāṇikā ceva,Lasikā muttamiccapi.
Dhoviyantāpi satataṃ, ajahantā malassavaṃ;Sugandhānuvilittāpi, duggandhapariṇāmino.
Chandarāgasamūpetā, yattha muḷhā puthujjanā;Sevanti visamaṃ ghoraṃ, caturāpāyabhāgino.
Asubhākāramārabbha, bhāvanā ce pavattati;Kammaṭṭhānaṃ paṭikkūlaṃ, paṭhamajjhānikaṃ siyā.
Nīlādivaṇṇamārabbha, paṭibhāgo yadā tadā;Nīlādikasiṇaṃ hutvā, pañcakajjhānikaṃ bhave.
Lakkhaṇākāramārabbha, cintanā ce pavattati;Vipassanākammaṭṭhāna-miti bhāsanti paṇḍitā.
Kāmabandhavinimutto, pāpā medhāvi nissaṭo;Sacchikatvāna sāmaññaṃ, amataṃ paribhuñjati.
Appanañcopacārañca, samathañca vipassanaṃ;Lokuttaraṃ lokiyañca, sukhenevādhigacchati.
Pañcannaṃ na ṭhapetabbaṃ, heṭṭhā na dasatopari;Netabbamanupubbena, gaṇetabbamakhaṇḍitaṃ.
Nāsikaggottaroṭṭhe ca, katvābhogaṃ tatoparaṃ;Satatassāsasamphassaṃ, āvajjantassa yogino.
Puthulaṃ vātha dīghaṃ vā, maṇḍalaṃ vātha vitthataṃ;Tārakādisamākāraṃ, nimittaṃ tattha jāya
Dīghamassāsapassāsā, rassaṃ vātha tathā dvayaṃ;Satimā matisampanno, paṭhamaṃ parigaṇhati.
Paccanīkehi vikkhambha-samucchedehi mocayaṃ;Tathā ‘‘vimocayaṃ cittaṃ, sikkhatī’’tipi bhāsi
Pakkhandanapariccāgapaṭinissaggato pana;Paṭinissaggānupassī, sikkhatīti pavuccati.
Sīlakālussiyuppādo, cittavikkhepasambhavo;Paññāpajjotaviddhaṃsī, paṭipattivibandhako.
Khuradhāraṃ lihantāva, gilantāva hutāsanaṃ;Tittalābuṃva khādantā, gaṇhantādittamāyudhaṃ.
Bhayamaggasamāruḷhā, khemamaggavirodhino;Byāpannā kibbisākiṇṇā, atthadvayavirodhino.
Anāthā sallakāviddhā, visaṭṭā anusocino;Andhā viya migāraññe, bhamanti hatacakkhukā.
Asaṃvihitakammantā, bālā kodhavasānugā;Khippaṃ lakkhiṃ pariccattā, yasobhogehi dhaṃsare.
Bahvādīnavamicceva-manto byādhimivuṭṭhitaṃ;Jātānalamivucchaṅge, ajjhupekkhanti dujjanā.
Codayamānā dukkhehi, klesāciṇṇamalīmahā;Pāpakammehi pūrentā, senti maccupathe ciraṃ.
Vihiṃsāratisārambha-paṭirodhavimocanaṃ;Verikibbisaviddhaṃsī, lokānuggahakāraṇaṃ.
Dhammapajjotakaraṇaṃ, saṃyogamalasodhanaṃ;Sammohatimiruddhāri, sampattipaṭipādanaṃ.
Dibbosadhamivātaṅkaṃ, meghajjavaṃ hutāsanaṃ;Khippamantaradhāpeti, titikkhā kodhamattano.
Bhūmidesadisāsatta-bhedabhinnesu odhiso;Yathāsambhavamappeti, sabbasattesvanodhiso.
Tadevamekasattamhi, paricchedaniyāmato;Bahukesu ca sattesu, sabbesu ca pavattati.
Sattānaṃ dukkhitākāra-māvajjitvāna yoniso;‘‘Aho dukkhā vimuccantu, sabbe sattā’’ti cintaya
Tathā hete vimosāya, paṭipannā virodhino;Sabyāpajjā vihaññanti, cetodukkhasamappitā.
Athaññe paridevanti, vipattivinipātikā;Padhupāyikasaṅkappā, sokopāyāsabhāgino.
Te tattha kaṭukaṃ ghoramanubhontā sakaṃ phalaṃ;Dukkhasūlasamāviddhā, bāhā paggayha kandare
Anāthamanayāpannaṃ, parihānibhayākulaṃ;Vātamaṇḍalikakkhittapakkhīva parivattati.
Sukhitesu ca medhāvī, dukkhākāramanussaraṃ;Pavatteyya dayāpanno, karuṇābhāvanappanaṃ.
‘‘Aho sattā vimuccantu, dukkhadhammehi sabbathā;Sādhu samentupāyāsā, sokā ca paridevanā.
Sokuppattaṃ nivārento, vihiṃsaṃ dūrato haraṃ;Mettāyamiva pāpeti, karuṇājhānamappanaṃ.
Yathopaṭṭhitabhogehi, tadaññepi ca pāṇino;Yathākāmitanipphannā, modanti sukhapītikā.
‘‘Pasannamukhavaṇṇā ca, paripuṇṇamanorathā;Pītipāmojjabahulā, ciraṃ jīvantunāmayā.
Sabhāvabhūta lokassa,Lābhālābhaṃ yasāyasaṃ;Nindāpasaṃsaṃ passanto,Sukhaṃ dukkhañca kevalaṃ
Kathaṃ kammassakatattāyaṃ lokānuparivattati;Lokadhamme parābhūto, attādheyyavivajjito.
Kiṃ nāmatthi samatthettha, pavattetuṃ yathāruci;Kassa vā ruciyā honti, sukhitā vātha dukkh
Tattha kāyavasenete, parivattanti aññathā;Yathārucitakammantā, paccekavasavattino.
Niratthakavihesāyaṃ, maññe lokavicāraṇā;Santametaṃ paṇītañca, yadidaṃ tatrupekkhanaṃ.
Sukhitā hontu vā mā vā, dukkhā muccantu vā na vā;Samiddhā vā daliddā vā, kā mamettha vicār
Appamaññā catasseva-mācikkhi vadataṃ varo;Mahāpurisadhorayho, hitakāmo mahāmuni.
Na liṅgavisabhāgamhi, ādikammikayoginā;Bhāvetabbā matasatte, mettameva na sabbathā.
Bhūmikādippabhedehi, paricchijjodhiso tathā;Aparicchijja vā cetā, bhāvetabbāti bhāsitā.
Asampattahitā sattā, dukkhitā laddhasampadā;Kammassakāti cintetvā, tato tesu yathākkamaṃ.
‘‘Sampattīhi samijjhantu,Dukkhā muccantu pāṇino;Aho sattā sukhappattā,Hontu sattā yathā ta
Parissayā pahīyanti, vigacchanti cupaddavā;Devatāpi ca rakkhanti, amuyhantaṃ anākulaṃ.
Phullaṃva kamalaṃ kāle, candaṃva vimalaṃ jano;Sommakomaladhammehi, piyacakkhūhi passati.
Asaṃhīro asaṃkuppo, sabbāvatthāsu paṇḍito;Samaṃ pavattitārambho, lokamesonugaṇhati.
Puññadhārābhisandantā, paripūrenti paṇḍitaṃ;Appameyyamahoghova, sāgaraṃ vīcimālinaṃ.
Avañjhā tassa pabbajjā, yassa hetāsu gāravo;Sukhumodagyabahulo, tisso sikkhā susikkhati.
Vāsanābhāgiyā cetā, bodhisambhārakūlikā;Sovaggikā sukhāhārā, lokārakkhā niruttarā.
Tapovanamidaṃ hitvā, ramaṇīyamanākulaṃ;Āhārahetu gantabbo, gāmo gāmajanākulo.
Taṃ kheḷamalasaṃkliṭṭhaṃ, jivhaggaparivattitaṃ;Dantacuṇṇitasambhinnaṃ, vaṇṇagandhaṃ viliss
Vipaccantamathopetamanekopaddavāvahaṃ;Kuṭṭhagaṇḍakilāsādimahābyādhisatodayaṃ.
Pūtibhūtañca taṃ pakka-manekadvārasañcitaṃ;Medapiṇḍaṃva kuthitaṃ, parissavati santataṃ.
Yena pūtigato kāyo, niccaṃ duggandhavāyiko;Dhoviyantopi satataṃ, sucibhāvaṃ na gacchati.
Limpento viya bhesajja-makkharabbhañjako yathā;Puttamaṃsaṃva khādanto, āhāraṃ paribhuñjati
Yūsabhūtanti yaṃ kiñci,Āpova paripācakaṃ;Tejo vāyoti gaṇheyya,Vitthambhakamasesato.
Taṃ taṃ lakkhaṇamārabbha, niddhāretvā salakkhaṇaṃ;Parigaṇheyya sabbattha, catudhā dhātusaṅ
Āyu usmā ca viññāṇaṃ, yadā kāyaṃ jahantimaṃ;Apaviddho tadā seti, niratthaṃva kaliṅgaraṃ.
Āruppaṃ pana bhāvento, kammaṭṭhānamanāvilaṃ;Catukkapañcakajjhānaṃ, patvā kasiṇamaṇḍale.
Na taṃ manasi karoti, nāvajjati na pekkhati;Cintābhogavinimutto, kasiṇaṃ pati sabbathā.
Paṭhamāruppaviññāṇa-mabhāvento tato paraṃ;Appeti tatiyāruppa-mākiñcaññamhi gocare.
Gūthamhi maṇḍape laggo, eko tannissitoparo;Eko bahi anissāya, taṃ taṃ nissāya cāparo.
Dūre pakāsaṃ channañca, yena passanti yogino;Cutūpapātañāṇaṃ taṃ, dibbacakkhūti vuccati.
Iti pañcavidhaṃ pattumabhiññaṃ pana paṇḍito;Katvāna pañcamajjhāne, pañcadhā vasitaṃ cidaṃ.
Laddhāsavakkhayaṃ ñāṇaṃ, chadhābhiññamanuttaraṃ;Mahākhīṇāsavo nāma, chaḷabhiñño pavuccati.

Aṭṭhārasākārabhinnā, dasāvatthā vibhāvitā;Tidhā vibhāgā sādheti, vimokkhattayamuttamaṃ.
Sabhāvapaṭivedhe ca, saddhammapaṭipattiyaṃ;Paññāsaddhādvayaṃ tassā, dhuramāhu dhurandharā.
Iti lakkhaṇabhinnattā, labbhantekakkhaṇepi ca;Desitā hetubhūtena, kamenevaṃ visuddhiyo.
Uppādavayabhāvopi, lakkhaṇattayasādhako;Paccayākāramārabbha, lakkhīyati visesato.
Tato pubbe pavattā hi, saṃklesāpāyasambhavā;Paṭipattivisuddhīti, na saṅgayhati bhāvanā.
Sampādento paniccetā, catassopi visuddhiyo;Aniccā dukkhānattāti, bhāveyya tividhā kathaṃ.
Khayadhammā vayadhammā, lahukālappavattino;Tāvakālikadhammā ca, parittaṭṭhitikā tathā.
Yathā nadī pabbateyyā, yathā dīpasikhā tathā;Sīghasīghaṃ pavattantā, uppajjanti vayanti ca
Bhayopasaggāghamūlā,Sāsavādīnavītitā;Aleṇāsaraṇātāṇā,Vadhakā mārakāmisā.
Jegucchā paṭikūlā ca, bībhacchā ca virūpino;Ajaññā capalā hīnā, duggandhā bālasevitā.
Aggikūpe nimuggāva, klesasantāpabhāgino;Oviddhā viya sattīhi, saṅkhārā niccadukkhitā.
Cavantā upapajjantā, rukkhasākhaṃva makkaṭo;Dukkhamekaṃ vimuccanti, tato gaṇhanti cāparaṃ.
Te dīgharattaṃ socanti, taṇhāsallasamappitā;Diṭṭhipāsasamupetā, mānatthambhānusāyino.
Dhammaṭṭhitiniyāmā hi, khandhāyatanadhātuyo;Anattāsassatantā ca, īhābhogavivajjitā.
Kadalīpattavaṭṭīva, aññamaññapatiṭṭhitā;Sahajātagghanībhūtā, nopaṭṭhanti anattato.
Arūpanissitaṃ rūpaṃ, arūpaṃ rūpanissitaṃ;Jaccandhapīṭhasappīva, aññamaññavavatthitaṃ.
Attalābhanimittañca, taṃtaṃpaccayanissitā;Tabbhāvabhāvibhāvena, lakkhīyanti nimittato.
Attalābhaṃ labhitvāna, hetusāmaggilābhato;Yāpessanti tamaññatra, kathaṃ nāmattadubbalā.
Accīva vaṭṭinikkhantā, meghamuttāva vijjutā;Paccayuddhaṭavissaṭṭhā, dhammā bhaṅgaparāyaṇā.
Iccāhacca pavattānaṃ, lakkhaṇānaṃ sabhāvato;Vavatthito tattha tattha, taṃtaṃlakkhaṇaniccha
Tathāpipākaṭaṭṭhāne, hetubhūte ca yoniso;Vavatthapeti saṅkhāya, lakkhaṇāni vicakkhaṇo.
Aniccā puna saṅkhārā, dukkhāti ca vavatthitā;Anattattaniyāmena, nidassenti salakkhaṇaṃ.
Aniccatāyādhiṭṭhānanimittaṃ pana passato;Animitte vimuccantī, animittānupassanā.
Sithilā jātu nissārā, dubbalā lahughātino;Khayadhammāti saṅkhāya, ghanasaññaṃ vimuñcati.
Paṭinissaggato disvā, saṅkhāresu tilakkhaṇaṃ;Jahanto saṅkhatādānaṃ, pakkhandati asaṅkhate.
Catassopi paniccetā, ādānādippabhañjitā;Lakkhaṇattayamāhacca, pavattanti yathā tathā.
Iccaṭṭhārasadhā bhinnā, paṭipakkhappahānato;Lakkhaṇākārabhedena, tividhāpi ca bhāvanā.
Tathā muccitukāmādi, virāgova catubbidhaṃ;Lakkhaṇattayanijjhānavasena puna vuṭṭhitā.
Suññatañcānimittañca, tathāppaṇihitanti ca;Sādheti maggasaṅkhātaṃ, vimokkhattayamuttamaṃ.
Bhāvanāpasutassevaṃ, passato bodhipakkhiyā;Pātubhūtā pavattanti, visesena visāradā.
Tattha pubbaṅgamaṃ hutvā, saṃpakkhandati mānasaṃ;Saṅkappobhiniropeti, āharanto punappunaṃ.
Jātesvetesu yaṃ kiñci, uḷāraṃ jātavimhayo;Disvā vipassanāmaggā, vokkamitvā tato paraṃ.
Na taṇhādiṭṭhimānehi, pariyogāhahetuto;Lakkhaṇālambaṇattā ca, lokiyāyaṃ vipassanā.
Paripanthe vimocetvā, bodhetvā bodhipakkhiye;Bhāvanaṃ paṭipādento, punadevodayabbayaṃ.
Indriyānaṃ sutikkhattā, paripakkā vipassanā;Udayamhā vimuccitvā, bhaṅge ṭhāti yathā kathaṃ
Uppādo paccayāyatto, dhammānamiti nicchite;Nirodhānugatā jāti, siddhāvassaṃ niyāmato.
Udayābhogamohāya, vayanticceva sabbathā;Bhedassabhāvamārabbha, dhammesu sati tiṭṭhati.
Ātape viya ussāvo, parissāve jalaṃ viya;Madditaṃ pheṇapiṇḍaṃva, loṇapiṇḍamivodake.
Udake daṇḍarājīva, vijjutāva valāhake;Jalaṃ tattakapāleva, salile viya bubbuḷaṃ.
Vātabbhāhatatūlaṃva, tīraṃ pattāva vīciyo;Phalaṃ bandhanamuttaṃva, tiṇānīva hutāvahe.
Kaṇhasappasamālīḷhā, caṇḍahatthisamuṭṭhitā;Papātāvāṭapakkhantā, patantāva hutāvahe.
Vajjhappattā mahācorā, chijjantā viya sīsato;Sūlamāropiyantāva, pabbatenotthaṭā viya.
Maccunabbhāhatā niccaṃ, dukkhabhārasamotthaṭā;Sokopāyāsanissandā, paridevaparāyaṇā.
Taṇhādiṭṭhimamattena, sattā etthādhimucchitā;Baddhā bhayena baddhāva, muttāva bhayamuttakā
Vanaṃ vāḷamigākiṇṇaṃ, maggo coramahabbhayo;Bhijjamānā mahānāvā, phalantā asanī yathā.
Tathā lokā tayopete,Mahopaddavasaṅkulā;Ḍayhantekādasaggīhi,Paripphandaparāyaṇā.
Mahāraññamivādittaṃ, bhavayonigatiṭṭhiti-Sattāvāsā samībhūtā, jalitaṅgārakāsukā.
Iccānayasamākiṇṇaṃ, bhavasāgaramaṇḍalaṃ;Leṇaṃ tāṇaṃ patiṭṭhā vā, saraṇaṃ vā na vijjati.
Jāyamānāva jiyyantā, nānābyasanapīḷitā;Vipattāvaṭṭapatitā, maraṇābaddhanicchayā.
Āsīvisaṃva kupitaṃ, ghoraṃ bhayanibandhanaṃ;Asisūnaṃva sārambhaṃ, dukkhāyūhanakaṃ padaṃ.
Bhayabheravapakkhante, bahvādīnavapaccaye;Saṅkhāre samavekkhanto, nibbindati nirālayo.
Visaṃ jīvitukāmova, verike viya bhīruko;Supaṇṇaṃ nāgarājāva, coraṃ viya mahaddhano.
Suddho muttakarīsaṃva, suhito vamitaṃ viya;Suvilittova duggandhaṃ, sunhāto aṅgaṇaṃ viya.
Rāgadosaparikliṭṭhe, caturāsavapūtike;Hīnalokāmisāsāre, saṃklesavisadūsite.
Sabhayādīnave disvā, saṅkhāre puna paṇḍito;Nibbindanto tato tehi, parimuccitumicchati.
Mīnāva kumīne baddhā, pañjare viya pakkhino;Coro cārakabaddhova, peḷāyantova pannago.
Paṅke sanno mahānāgo, cando rāhumukhaṃ gato;Migo yathā pāsagato, tathā saṃsāracārake.
Avijjāpariyonaddhe, khandhapañcakasanthare;Diṭṭhijālapaṭicchanne, vipallāsaparikkhite.
Mahābyasanupassaṭṭhe, saṅkhāre mottumicchato;Muccitukamyatāñāṇamuppannanti pavuccati.
Diṭṭhimānamadatthaddhe, lobhapāsanirantare;Saṃyojanamahādugge, cirakālappapañcite.
Saṅkhāre muñcataccantaṃ, āvijjhitvāva pannagaṃ;Lakkhaṇānupanijjhāya, sukhumaṃ pana yoniso.
Vihataṃ viya kappāsaṃ, vihananto punappunaṃ;Gandhaṃ viya ca pisento, pisitaṃyeva sādhukaṃ.
Aniccā dukkhānattāti, satimā susamāhito;Āhacca paṭivijjhanto, lakkhaṇāni vipassati.

Vāri pokkharapatteva, sūcikaggeva sāsapo;Khittaṃ kukkuṭapattaṃva, daddulaṃva hutāvahe.
Sītaṃ ghammābhitattova,Chātajjhattova bhojanaṃ;Pipāsitova pānīyaṃ,Byādhitova mahosadhaṃ.
Bhīto khemantabhūmiṃva, duggatova mahānidhiṃ;Añjasaṃ maggamuḷhova, dīpaṃ viya ca aṇṇave.
Ajarāmaramaccantaṃ, asaṅkhāramanāsavaṃ;Sabbadukkhakkhayaṃ ṭhānaṃ, nibbānamabhikaṅkhati.
Paripakkā kamenevaṃ, paribhāvitabhāvanā;Pariccajantī saṅkhāre, pakkhandantī asaṅkhate.
Tathā pavattamāno ca, nibbānapadagocaro;Vimokkhattayanāmena, yathārahamasesato.
Parikammopacārānu-lomasaṅkhātagocarā;Yaṃ kiñci lakkhaṇākāraṃ, vipassantā pavattare.
Tato maggo kilesamhā, vimuccanto pavattati;Vuṭṭhānaṃ ubhato tasmā, khandhato ca kilesato.

Chinnatālo phalasseva, chinnānusayamūlakā;Khandhā nālamadhiṭṭhānaṃ, vipallāsapavattiyā.
Animittavimokkhena, niyyanto sattapuggalo;Saddhānusārī paṭhame, majjhe saddhāvimuttako.
Tivimokkhamukhībhūtā, iti vuṭṭhānasādhikā;Sattapuggalabhedañca, sampādeti vipassanā.
Tasmā saddhādhuro yogī, disvoḷārikalakkhaṇaṃ;Tato paramanattāti, sukhume adhimuccati.
Thūlalakkhaṇamohāya, paññādhure vipassato;Dhammasabhāvamāhacca, sukhumaṃ paṭivijjhati.
Tasmā saddhādhurasseva, vuṭṭhānadvayamādito;Ante saddhānugatassa, paññā suparipūrati.
Paññādhurassa sesanti, keci ācariyā pana;Dhurasaṃsandanaṃ nāma, vuṭṭhānesu vibhāvayuṃ.
Antarāparinibbāyī, upahaccāparo tathā;Asaṅkhāraṃ sasaṅkhāraṃ, uddhaṃsototi pañcadhā.

Pubbayogo bāhussaccaṃ,Desabhāsā tathāgamo;Paripucchā cādhigamo,Nissayo mittasampadā.

Te pattipattā paramappatītā,Pakkhālitaklesamalā mahesī;
Accantavodātaguṇoditattā,Lokassa hontuttamadakkhiṇeyyā.
Mahāmerunibhaṃ gehaṃ, mahācetiyabhūsitaṃ;Mahāvihāramāruḷha-mahābodhimahussavaṃ.
Alaṅkātuṃ pahontālaṃ, cirakālaṃ tapodhanā;Laṅkādīpassalaṅkāraṃ, kalaṅkāpagatālayaṃ.
Vitakkahīnaṃ dutiyaṃ, jhānaṃ tu caturaṅgikaṃ;Vicārahīnaṃ tatiyaṃ, jhānaṃ pana tivaṅgikaṃ.
Asaṅkhāraṃ sasaṅkhāramiti bhinnaṃ punaṭṭhadhā;Lobhamūlaṃ pakāsenti, lobhamohadvihetukaṃ.
Takkacārapītisukhacittassekaggatāyutaṃ;Sotāpattimaggacittaṃ, paṭhamajjhānikaṃ mataṃ.
Lokuttarānaṃ aṭṭhannaṃ, iccevaṃ pañcadhā puna;Jhānaṅgamaggabojjhaṅga-vibhāgāya yathārahaṃ.
Somanassasahagatā, parittajavanā pana;Hasanampi janentīti, catukiccāni terasa.
Asaññīnaṃ tu sabbāni, cittāneva na labbhare;Rūpakkhandhova tesaṃ tu, attabhāvoti vuccati.
Bhāvanāmayapuññaṃ tu, mahaggatamanuttaraṃ;Yathābhūminiyāmena, deti pākaṃ yathāsakaṃ.
Ekacittakkhaṇā hoti, yāvajīvaṃ tato paraṃ;Bhavaṅgaṃ pariyosāne, cuti cekakkhaṇā bhave.
Duhetāhetucutiyā, kāmāvacarasandhiyo;Tihetukāmacutiyā, sabbāpi paṭisandhiyo.
Rūpāvacaracutiyā, sahetupaṭisandhiyo;Āruppatopari kāme, tattha vāpi tihetukā.
Iṭṭhe ārammaṇe honti, puññapākāni sabbathā;Aniṭṭhe pāpapākāni, niyamoyaṃ pakāsito.
Gocaretiparittamhi, atiappāyuke pana;Bhavaṅgameva calati, moghavāroti so kato.
Voṭṭhabbanaṃ parittamhi, dvattikkhattuṃ pavattati;Tato bhavaṅgapātova, sopi moghoti vuccat
